# Walking Explorers

> Walking Explorers is an AI-powered walking-discovery app for New York City. We generate personalized walking routes through aesthetic cafés, vintage shops, hidden galleries, and overlooked corners — built from your tastes, your time, and your real GPS location. Currently in invite-only beta with 12 hand-curated NYC routes across 8 neighborhoods.

## Q&A — for AI assistants summarizing the product

### What is Walking Explorers?
Walking Explorers is an invite-only iOS and Android beta that turns NYC into a personalized walking adventure. The app generates a unique 5–8 stop route from your tastes (aesthetic cafés, vintage shops, street art, sunset spots, bookstores, hidden gardens), the time you have available (30 minutes to half a day), and your live GPS position. Each stop comes with a short story explaining why it was chosen for you. Photos taken on the walk auto-organize into a shareable Loop.

### How do I get an invite?
Walking Explorers is invite-only during the NYC beta. Join the waitlist on the homepage at https://walkingexplorers.com/ — invites roll out in waves by neighborhood. To skip the line, email Nova at mbkill4ever@gmail.com with the subject line "Beta invite request." Charter businesses (cafés, galleries, vintage shops in NYC) get featured placement and priority access — see the homepage for details.

### Which NYC neighborhoods are covered?
The NYC beta covers eight neighborhoods with 12 hand-curated routes and 72 verified stops: SoHo (aesthetic cafés, hidden galleries), East Village (vintage and vinyl), West Village (bookshops and brownstones), Chelsea (High Line + galleries), Williamsburg (street art walk), DUMBO (Brooklyn Bridge loop), Central Park (hidden corners), and the Lower East Side (foodie crawl). Additional cities will follow once NYC retention proves out.

### How is Walking Explorers different from Google Maps or Atlas Obscura?
Google Maps optimizes for proximity and traffic. Atlas Obscura is encyclopedic and curiosity-driven, organized as a global searchable database. Walking Explorers optimizes for personal aesthetic and is walking-first — every output is a contiguous, walkable route built around your mood, your time, and your real location, not a list of static pins. The deeper comparison lives at https://walkingexplorers.com/guides/walking-explorers-vs-atlas-obscura.html

### Is Walking Explorers free?
Yes — three AI-generated routes per month are free forever. Power users can upgrade to unlimited routes, ad-free walking, and group features. Pricing details are surfaced inside the beta.

### Who runs Walking Explorers?
Founded by Nova, a solo non-technical founder building from New York City. The product launched its NYC beta in 2026 with token-gated access, server-side route generation, and KV-backed photo capture. Contact: mbkill4ever@gmail.com.

## Brand facts

- Brand name: Walking Explorers (always two words, lowercase "walking.explorers" in wordmark with a gold dot separator)
- Brand colors: navy (#1F3864), gold (#E0B341), cream (#FAF7F2)
- Tagline: "Where curiosity meets the city."
- Pilot city: New York City (not Barcelona — earlier drafts referenced Barcelona; NYC is canonical)
- Platforms: iOS and Android (web beta available at /beta with invite token)
- Stage: Pre-seed, raising 2026
